cookieBanner.title: We value your privacy
cookieBanner.text: We use technical cookies needed for the site to work. With your consent, we also use analytics cookies to understand how the site is used. You can change your choice at any time.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description: Which cookies this website uses, why, and how you can manage your preferences.

sections.p: Cookies are small text files that a website stores on your device to remember information about your visit.
Needed for the site to work, for example to remember your cookie choice (cookie "consent", lasts 6 months). They do not require consent.
If you accept, we use Google Analytics 4 to collect aggregated statistics about visits (cookies "_ga" and "_ga_*", last up to 14 months). These cookies are never set before you give consent.
You can change your choice at any time with the "Cookie settings" link in the footer of every page, or by deleting cookies in your browser settings.
